Strong Junior\Middle General QA Engineer

Blackthorn Vision
$$$

Blackthorn Vision is looking for a Strong Junior\Middle General QA Engineer. Our client, established in 2011 and based in Colorado, is a leading player in the U.S. application management market. We’ve had a successful partnership with this client and are seeking candidates who are eager to take ownership and improve a product already trusted by over 6,000 enterprises.

 

Requirements:

  • ~2+ years of hands-on QA experience — primarily manual, with some exposure to automation.
  • Good understanding of test planning, risk assessment, test design, execution, and defect reporting.
  • Experience testing web and desktop applications, including verifying installs on virtual machines (VMs).
  • Hands-on REST API testing with Swagger (OpenAPI).
  • Basic experience querying MongoDB (NoSQL) to validate test data.
  • Comfortable with Azure DevOps for test documentation and defect tracking; familiarity with CI/CD concepts (tests run via Azure DevOps Pipelines).
  • Basic Git (branch, commit, push, pull requests).
  • Exposure to automation with Playwright + TypeScript — or a strong desire and ability to learn it.
  • Proficiency with browser developer tools (Console, Network, Application) and basic debugging via browser logs / network traffic analysis.
  • Ability to identify automation candidates while testing manually.
  • Comfortable using VS Code + GitHub Copilot to assist test-plan / test-case creation.
  • Experience working in Agile teams.

  • Upper-Intermediate level of English.

     

    Nice to Have

  • Experience with AI-assisted testing tools (GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, Claude, etc.).
  • Exposure to CI/CD pipeline configuration or contributing to a test automation framework.

  • Docker basics (occasionally used to run tests on local test environments).

     

    Responsibilities

  • Own feature quality primarily through manual testing (~70%): test planning, design, execution, and defect reporting.
  • Contribute to automation (~30%): write and maintain Playwright/TypeScript tests for suitable cases and help improve the framework.
  • Create, execute, and maintain manual (and some automated) test cases, test documentation, and regression suites in Azure DevOps.
  • Perform functional, regression, API (Swagger), and backend testing (APIs, MongoDB, logs), including install verification on VMs; basic non-functional checks.
  • Identify, document, track, and verify defects; debug basic issues via browser logs and network traffic.
  • Identify repetitive scenarios worth automating and flag/automate them.
  • Analyze test results and communicate findings; participate in Agile ceremonies.

  •  Contribute to post-release quality analysis (Root Cause Analysis) and preventive improvements.

     

We offer:

  • exciting and challenging work in a friendly and professional environment;
  • excellent career opportunities and competitive salary;
  • on-site visits to customers;
  • flexible work schedule;
  • professional development program with internal seminars on technical topics;
  • courses, certifications, and access to the corporate library;
  • free English classes;
  • 18 working days of paid vacation (24 calendar days), 5 full-paid sick leave days, paid public holidays;
  • medical insurance;
  • maternity leave;
  • IT club membership;
  • employee referral program;
  • recognition program with gifts and awards;
  • pet-friendly and eco-friendly;
  • direct and easy communication with management and much more.
